title: Jerusalem — continuous urban biography
principle: One terrain and coordinate system. Construction, expansion, destruction, abandonment, burial, reuse and rebuilding are all first-class temporal events. Never jump between isolated city models.

phases.label: 最早聚落
phases.note: Earliest occupation belongs to the southeastern ridge / spring landscape; do not invent monumental city fabric.

phases.label: 迦南城市
phases.note: Public architecture and fortified urban development emerge around the Gihon/eastern slope.

phases.label: 晚青銅—鐵器早期
phases.note: Represent occupation intensity and debated urban form rather than a smooth growth curve.

phases.label: 大衛—所羅門
phases.note: Biblical royal-building coordinate; archaeological extent and specific monumental identifications remain debated.

phases.label: 第一聖殿晚期
phases.note: Major westward expansion and fortification become visible.

phases.label: 巴比倫毀城
phases.note: Destruction must be animated as loss/ruin, not skipped as a date marker.

phases.label: 波斯—尼希米
phases.note: Smaller post-exilic city and wall reconstruction layer.

phases.label: 希臘化—哈斯蒙尼
phases.note: Urban recovery and expansion toward the Second Temple city.

phases.label: 大希律—耶穌
phases.note: Temple-platform and dense Second Temple city; hosts Biblical Route 01: Jesus Entry.

phases.label: 羅馬毀城
phases.note: Destruction event alters walls, monumental fabric and occupation.

phases.label: Aelia Capitolina
phases.note: Roman replanning is a new urban layer, not restoration of the Herodian city.

phases.label: 拜占庭
phases.note: Christian monumental city and street network.

phases.label: 早期伊斯蘭
phases.note: Haram/Temple Mount monumental transformation and changing southern urban fabric.

phases.label: 十字軍
phases.note: Reuse and reconstruction of existing city fabric.

phases.label: 阿尤布—馬穆魯克
phases.note: Layered rebuilding, institutions, streets and reused fabric.

phases.label: 奧斯曼
phases.note: Present Old City wall/gate system becomes a major visible layer; Jaffa Gate belongs here.

phases.label: 城外擴張
phases.note: City breaks decisively beyond the Old City walls.

phases.label: 現代耶路撒冷
phases.note: Modern metropolitan fabric grows around the ancient topography; current political boundaries are not encoded as historical certainty.
